outcome.technical: plugins/audit/scripts/_machine_paths.py: split the posix-home predicate. _writer_fires (read by machine_path_shape, so by check_free_text, redacted_free_text and executed_value_refusal) requires a separator before the home word again, so a relative path under a repository's own home directory is stored as typed at any depth. shape_fires (the detector's, read by tools/check-committed-pii.py and mp16) is the writer's answer plus _cut_home_fires: depth >= _HOME_PATH_MIN_DEPTH (unchanged at 3), or below it, the macOS capitalised Users root or a hidden entry (separator, dot, name char) beneath the user segment. The measurement of both sides sits beside the rule with the command that re-derives it. The UNC arm of windows-user-path now requires one escaping depth: two backslashes then one (raw), or four then two (JSON); the two-or-more-character server/share requirement is kept and pinned. tools/check-committed-pii.py: new _reader_split_cases with the writer-door case (title opens with the tests.add clause; deep relative home path stored by check_free_text/redacted_free_text/machine_path_shape, separator-led twin still refused, detector still reports it), q2k (shallow cut paths found, the recorded prose plus a file and a parent reference beneath a user stay quiet), q2l (doubled-escaped newline followed by a word, and one-letter escapes at a single depth, quiet; raw share, escaped share and escaped C: Users home found). BASELINE: removed the P82 windows-user-path row (octal git-quoted file name), now dead because the share needs one escaping depth; added four posix-home rows for the review finding text that quotes the shallow cut spellings under a placeholder user (reviewer return line 378, journal fb1bddcc line 475, two P125.json line anchors), verified by reading the matched segment as the placeholder, never printing it. Comments that called shape_fires the one predicate both readers call were rewritten. outcome.descriptive: The writer stores a repository's own relative home paths again, the PII check finds shallow cut home paths without flagging prose, and an escaped newline followed by a word is no longer read as a Windows share.
